title: Zstandard signature
summary: A Zstandard file begins with the 4-byte magic 0x28 0xB5 0x2F 0xFD (little-endian: 0xFD2FB528).
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: Zstandard is a fast compression algorithm developed by Facebook.
Compression levels 1-22; dictionaries for small data.
Used by Linux kernel, Btrfs, SquashFS, and many modern systems.
